name: Mishra's Foundry — becomes an Assembly-Worker, and "target attacking Assembly-Worker gets +2/+2" works
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). The hyphenated type was written "Assembly-worker", which no type catalog knows, so the Foundry (and Mishra's Factory) became a creature with no subtype and "target attacking Assembly-Worker" was no subject at all. singularizeCreatureType capitalises each hyphenated part. Foundry A animates and is pumped by Foundry B: a 4/4 Assembly-Worker.
